scope: All 364 stored cases (316 occurrences plus 48 claim anchors): full evidence, flyswatter/inference discipline, gloss/search hygiene, different-things sense test, actor/action and attribution prose.
hashCondition: Verdicts bind only the exact entry hashes listed. No gate, promotion, merge, or site mutation was performed.

findings.finding: REVISE — gloss/search hygiene: “play with the vital spirit” merely translates the components and remains opaque to an English reader even though the evidence establishes a stock disparaging action applied to empty or fixed displays of speech, understanding, and conduct. Preserve the literal image, but add a corpus-earned functional gloss/search alias that identifies it as a rebuke without inventing what 精魂 is.
findings.formalizationCondition: Independent verdict applies only to this exact formally gated SHA-256.

findings.finding: REVISE — gloss/search hygiene: every target and search alias repeats the metal-anatomy image, while the article itself establishes that the phrase is a substantivized epithet for a formidable Chan fellow and explicitly denies literal metal anatomy. Add an English functional alias such as “a formidable fellow” qualified by the attested context; keep the literal image visible.
